comments.no-angular-here: @angular/* is deliberately NOT declared. This app is outside the root workspaces glob (D014) and installs into its own node_modules, so declaring the framework here produced a SECOND physical copy of it. The application builder resolves @angular/ssr from the WORKSPACE ROOT when it injects the server manifests, so an SSR build then mixed two @angular/core instances and died during route extraction with NG0201 'No provider found for InjectionToken PlatformDestroyListeners. Source: Platform: core'. Resolving the framework upward to the monorepo root - which is where the builder itself comes from - keeps exactly one copy. D014/D015 are about ngx-foundation-sites, which is still installed here as a real registry tarball, and verify-registry-consumption.mjs still gates that.
comments.why-these-three: express is server.ts's host, foundation-sites is what the library's public Sass @imports, and ngx-foundation-sites is the subject of the whole proof. None of them carry DI identity, so a duplicate copy is harmless.
